title: Wildly Energizing Uruguayan Hake Ceviche
description: A refreshing and energizing Uruguayan dish featuring hake, this ceviche is perfect for a light lunch or snack, with an earthy and fluffy texture from the addition of crunchy vegetables and a zesty marinade.
instructions: Cut the hake fillets into small cubes and place them in a fondue pot.
Squeeze the lime juice over the hake cubes and toss to coat.
Add the mixed greens, red onion, cilantro, garlic, lemon zest, salt, and pepper to the fondue pot.
Cover the fondue pot with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, fill a large bowl with ice and place the fondue pot in the center of the bowl.
Pour cold water over the ice to create an ice bath, which will help to shock the hake and stop the cooking process.
Serve the ceviche immediately, garnished with additional cilantro and lime wedges if desired.
